Date: 2026-11-17.
Provenance: **reified, primary-banked**. The law-test census below is the
committed run output of `tests/testthat/test-hrd-independent.R` on this
change set's tree (RED FAIL 9 / PASS 0 witnessed before the helper existed;
GREEN PASS 38 / FAIL 0 after); the roster figures are the committed
generator's own report. No figure here comes from lane lore.

## 1. Mandate and what "independent" must mean

The novelty scan §4 R8 ruled: the HRD/pLOH/aneuploidy fidelity reference is
the team's own prior package (CRAN sigminer 2.3.3 lineage), so the CS-2
byte-exactness bars must be labeled that way *until an independent reference
lands*. The label landed; this devlog lands the reference. "Independent" here
carries teeth: a second transcription of the same source files is one
derivation wearing two hats, so the new face —
`tests/testthat/helper-hrd-independent.R` — was read **from the published
Cortes-Castro 2020 (Cancer Research) classifier definitions alone**,
consulting none of the implementation-lineage files. The independence is
also enforced mechanically: the law test scans the independent file for any
lineage symbol and refuses the change set if one appears.

## 2. The adjudication table

The published definitions pin the semantics but leave open a handful of
readings; each is chosen EXPLICITLY in the header and probed at its boundary
so the two derivations can never part silently: closed-interval widths
(`end - start + 1`); the LOH fold `minor' = min(total - minor, minor)` with
LOH iff `total >= 1 & minor' == 0`; the whole-chromosome half-weight arm
split (0.5/0.5, not full weight per arm); the opt-in acrocentric p-arm
blacklist (13, 14, 15, 21, 22); the two NA-drop scopes (pLOH drops four
columns, the arm scan three); the autosome universe `chr1..chr22`.

## 3. What the cross-adjudication measured

On the planted grammar (LOH-heavy, LOH-poor, aneu-rich, fold-trap rows), the
fold trap included (`total 4, minor 4` folds to LOH; `total 4, minor 3`
must not), on the R7 committed B1-B6 cohort with its committed hg19 arm
table, and on the four boundary probes, the two derivations agree **byte-
exact** (fractions to 1e-12, counts `identical`): PASS 38 / FAIL 0. The
lineage families show no regression (51/67 PASS) and the CI roster lockstep
re-mints clean (files=96, t0-weight 612s under the 800s ceiling,
test-ci-shard-map.R 212 PASS).

## 4. What this upgrades in the manuscript

The CS-2 claims now speak the truth: the headline row is
*dual-derivation byte-exactness*, the §3.4 framing note names the lineage
split with both faces, and the §9 ground-truth-lineage item reads as
delivered rather than as promised — the implementation-lineage face and the
published-definition face cross-adjudicated, the R7 scarHRD competitor face
riding beside them as third-party observation. Nothing was promoted that
was not measured first: the upgrade sentences were written only after the
38-unit agreement stood green.
